# YRecall
YRecall — Your AI-Powered Personal Memory System

## What is YRecall?
YRecall is an AI-powered personal memory system designed to help you capture, organize, search, and recall the information that matters in your life. It acts as a second brain and personal knowledge management tool for your daily life.

## Who develops YRecall?
YRecall is built by LYFSpot, an independent product company focused on high-quality, consumer-first software for real life. It was founded by Sravan Sai Vuppula.

## What features are currently available?
Users can capture notes, search their personal memory, organize moments, and reliably retrieve information. It uses a clean, mobile-first interface designed for speed and clarity.

## Is YRecall available on Android?
Yes, YRecall is available on Android. The official pre-release APK can be downloaded directly from the official website.
